note: Receptionist answers — the 10 questions HTC Christchurch gets asked most. Instant answers in the Ask section; anything else goes to the inbox.

items.a: Depends how you want to train: 3-Day Trial — £30 (one-off — 3 days). All-Access — £55 (per month). HYROX Squad — £40 (per month). 1:1 Coaching — £150 (per month). Rolling monthly, no lock-in — details on the plans section below.
Yes — the 3-Day Trial gives you the full run of the place: sessions, open gym, the lot. Most people who try a week stay.

items.q: I've never done HYROX — can beginners join?
items.a: That's most of the room, honestly. Every station scales, nobody's watching your numbers, and Ross will tell you the same: show up twice a week and the rest takes care of itself.

An indoor fitness race: eight 1km runs with a workout station between each — SkiErg, sled push, sled pull, burpee broad jumps, row, farmers carry, lunges, wall balls. Open, Pro, Doubles and Relay divisions, so everyone can race.
We're in Christchurch — exact session locations go out in the member group each week, and the site has the details under Events. Parking's never been an issue.
Session times are on the diary page and go out weekly in the group — typically early morning and evening slots so it fits around work. Check the diary or just ask.

items.q: Do you run HYROX sim days?
items.a: Yes — full race simulations with real timing and transitions, the closest thing to race day without the ticket. Members get first shout; dates land on the events page.

Yes — 1:1 coaching is on the plans. Technique work, race prep, or just faster progress than group sessions alone. Message Ross directly and you'll get a straight answer on whether it's worth it for you.
Rolling monthly — cancel whenever, no exit forms, no guilt-trip retention script. If you leave, the door stays open.

items.q: I'm looking for a doubles partner
items.a: Post a card on the find-a-partner board — pace band, race target, one line about you. Ross matches people by hand, because doubles is chemistry, not just split times.
